title: Power Integrity Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Role and Impact
As a Power Integrity Engineer, you will play a vital role in designing and delivering robust power integrity solutions for cutting-edge platforms, boards, packages, and silicon. You will analyze power delivery networks, perform simulations, and ensure optimal power integrity for the next generation of Intel technologies. Your contributions will directly impact the performance and reliability of Intel products, driving innovation in computing solutions.

Business group
You will be part of Intel Products Group, working within a dynamic team that focuses on developing advanced technologies to support Intel's broader mission of delivering world-class computing solutions. The group emphasizes innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence to address challenges in power delivery and integrity, ensuring exceptional product performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver power integrity solutions for complex high-speed platforms, boards, packages, and silicon.
  • Develop and analyze power delivery networks using 2D/3D model extraction and noise analysis methodologies.
  • Define power grid specifications and balance power integrity with performance and area targets.
  • Design test structures, perform electrical analysis, and verify power delivery networks against pre-silicon estimations.
  • Apply expertise in power integrity design to guide physical implementation for packages and platforms.
  • Develop platform-level power shapes and decoupling solutions for end customers.
  • Derive platform-level specifications from silicon requirements, ensuring convergence on feature sets and voltage regulation performance.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize power integrity across silicon, package, and platform integration.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or a related field with 0-2 years of hands-on experience in power integrity design and analysis, with demonstrated skills gained through internships, academic projects, coursework, or hands-on training OR a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field with no prior professional experience.
  • Proficiency in EDA tools such as Cadence Sigrity tools, Synopsys HSPICE, or similar software.
  • Strong understanding of platform-level power delivery and VR performance characterization techniques.
  • Experience with 2D and 3D model extraction and noise analysis methodologies.

title: System and Hardware Enabling Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Intel Edge Computing Engineering Team is on a mission to enable successful ODMs and customers in India to develop differentiated Edge products based on Intel technologies. 


The team is looking for an experienced Digital Design Engineer with strong board-level hardware design, design-review, hardware-enabling and debug expertise to support customers developing platforms based on Intel Core and Atom processors. 


The engineer will work closely with customer hardware teams through the complete board design and enabling lifecycle, including schematic design and review, high-speed interface implementation, PCB layout review, prototype board bring-up, hardware debug, root-cause analysis and resolution of design issues. 

The role requires strong hands-on knowledge of processor-based digital hardware design and the ability to independently review and debug complex customer boards.


The engineer will also provide periodic technical training to customers and proactively support customer design-review, board-debug and technical-support requests to help accelerate successful product development.


Key Responsibilities:


1.    Board-Level Digital Design and Review: Support board-level digital hardware design and conduct detailed design reviews for customer products based on Intel Core and Atom processors. 


2.    Schematic Review: Review customer schematics against Intel Platform Design Guides, reference schematics, datasheets, design checklists and other technical collateral, and identify potential design issues before PCB fabrication. 


3.    Digital Interface Design: Review processor interfaces and associated circuitry, including DDR4/DDR5/LPDDR4/LPDDR5 memory; PCIe; USB; SATA; DisplayPort/eDP/HDMI and other display interfaces; Ethernet and connectivity interfaces; I2C/SMBus, SPI, UART and GPIO; and clock, reset, boot/configuration straps and other platform control signals. 


4.    PCB Layout Review: Review multilayer PCB stack-up and board layout implementation for processor-based platforms, including controlled impedance, high-speed routing, length matching, differential-pair routing, reference planes, via structures and signal-return paths for compliance with Intel layout guidelines and industry best practices. 


5.    High-Speed Digital Design: Perform detailed schematic and layout reviews of high-speed digital interfaces, particularly DDR, PCIe and USB, and recommend corrective actions based on Intel design guidelines and sound high-speed digital design practices. 


6.    Component Selection and Implementation: Support selection and design implementation of board-level digital components including memory devices, clock devices, level translators, buffers, multiplexers, switches, retimers, interface controllers and supporting logic. 


7.    Board Bring-Up and Debug: Drive and support customer board bring-up, including initial power-on, processor initialization, boot failures, memory initialization issues, high-speed interface failures and other board-level hardware issues. 


8.    Hands-On Lab Debug: Use lab debug equipment such as oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, I2C/SMBus tools and programmers to isolate and resolve hardware issues. 


9.    Root-Cause Analysis: Analyze hardware debug data to identify root causes, differentiate between schematic, PCB-layout, component, assembly, manufacturing and configuration-related issues, and recommend corrective actions. 


10.  Customer Issue Resolution: Actively support and drive resolution of customer technical issues, design-review requests and board-debug requests on an ongoing and periodic basis, working with customers from problem definition through root-cause identification and closure. 


11.  Customer Technical Training: Develop and deliver periodic technical training sessions and workshops for customer engineering teams covering Intel processor-based board design, hardware design guidelines, high-speed interfaces, schematic/layout best practices, board bring-up and debug methodologies. 

12.  Customer Hardware Enabling: Provide hands-on technical guidance to customer hardware engineers during schematic design, PCB development, prototype bring-up, EVT/DVT and initial product-enabling phases. 


13.  Cross-Functional Issue Resolution: Collaborate with Intel silicon, platform, validation, BIOS/Firmware and other engineering teams when customer hardware issues require cross-functional investigation and resolution. 


14.  Technical Communication: Effectively communicate design-review findings, technical risks, debug results and recommended corrective actions to customer and internal engineering teams. 


15.  Design Best Practices: Develop and maintain hardware design-review checklists, debug procedures, technical training materials, design best practices and lessons learned for reuse across customer programs. 


16. Customer Engagement: Periodically engage with customer engineering teams to review active designs, understand technical issues and provide timely engineering support throughout their product-development lifecycle.  

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics/Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, with 8 to 12 years of relevant industry experience, preferably including substantial hands-on experience in processor-based board design and debug. 
  • Strong hands-on experience designing and debugging complex multilayer digital boards, preferably using Intel Core/Atom or similar high-performance processor/SoC platforms. 
  • Experience in schematic capture and review using industry-standard EDA tools such as Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, Siemens/Mentor Graphics Xpedition or equivalent. 
  • Strong experience in processor-based schematic design/review, including CPU/SoC interfaces, DDR memory, PCIe, USB, SATA, display interfaces, Ethernet/connectivity, clock/reset, SPI/I2C/SMBus/UART/GPIO, and boot and configuration circuitry. 
  • Strong understanding of high-speed digital board design principles, including controlled impedance, differential signaling, termination, propagation delay, length/skew matching, crosstalk, return-path discontinuities and via effects. 
  • Experience with 8 to 16+ layer PCB designs, PCB stack-ups and placement/routing reviews for complex processor platforms. 
  • Ability to interpret and apply processor datasheets, platform design guides, reference schematics, layout guidelines and hardware design checklists to customer hardware designs. 
  • Strong hands-on experience with board bring-up and hardware failure analysis, particularly processor boot, memory initialization and high-speed interface issues. 
  • Experience using lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers and other board-level debug tools. 
  • Good understanding of PCB fabrication, assembly processes, DFM/DFT considerations and hardware failure mechanisms. 
  • Ability to independently analyze complex board-level problems, perform root-cause analysis and drive technical issues toward corrective action and closure. 
  • Ability to work directly with customers, manage multiple concurrent design-review and debug requests, and provide timely technical support. 
  • Strong technical presentation and communication skills with the ability to conduct technical training and workshops for customer engineering teams. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience designing, reviewing or supporting boards based on Intel Core or Atom processors. 
  • Experience with embedded and Edge compute designs such as COM Express, COM-HPC, 3.5-inch SBC, Mini-ITX, embedded compute modules and custom industrial platforms. 
  • Hands-on experience with DDR4/DDR5/LPDDR memory design, layout review and debug. 
  • Experience reviewing high-speed interfaces such as PCIe Gen4/Gen5, USB 3.x/USB4, DisplayPort and high-speed Ethernet. 
  • Familiarity with industry-standard Signal Integrity analysis/simulation tools from Cadence, Siemens EDA or equivalent, with the ability to understand and interpret simulation results. 
  • Experience working directly with ODM/OEM/customer engineering teams during schematic review, PCB review, prototype board bring-up and technical issue resolution. 
  • Experience developing and delivering technical training, workshops or design-guideline sessions for hardware engineering teams. 
  • Strong customer-facing communication, problem-solving and technical presentation skills. 
  • Willingness to travel to customer locations across India on a need basis for design reviews, technical training, board bring-up and hardware debug support. 


Primary Location: Bangalore, India 


Travel to customer locations across India on a need basis to support hardware design reviews, customer technical training, board bring-up and debug activities.

title: Senior Network Security/AI Software Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Senior Network Security Software Development Engineer will lead the architecture, development, and delivery of open-source, high-performance network security and AI reference solutions for the Network Software Enabling team in the Enterprise/Cloud Networking segment. This role works closely with architects, customers, and ecosystem partners to define technical requirements and to build reference workloads, with best known methods and configurations, optimized for Intel® Xeon® processors and accelerators across on-prem, edge, and cloud deployments.

The successful candidate will drive the design and optimization of security data planes and AI-enabled security workloads. These include Next-Generation Firewall, Secure Web Gateway, SD-WAN etc. focusing on key performance areas such as scale-up, load distribution, crypto processing, pattern matching, and the migration to AI-driven security functions. The role requires expertise in high-performance packet processing, network security functions, hardware acceleration, performance engineering, and deployment automation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture and technical roadmap for one or more network security reference solutions, and keep design consistent across the portfolio.
  • Design and optimize packet-processing and security pipelines for throughput, latency, and TCO on current and upcoming Intel® Xeon® platforms.
  • Integrate hardware acceleration technologies (QAT, AVX-512/AMX, NIC offloads) into open-source security stacks such as Snort3, VPP, and Hyperscan.
  • Enable and optimize AI/ML models for security use cases such as malicious URL detection, phishing and fraud detection, anomaly detection, and encrypted traffic analysis, utilizing technologies such as OpenVINO™, vLLM.
  • Lead performance characterization, define benchmarking methods, and produce the collateral that shows customer value.
  • Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) automation for cloud and edge deployment, provisioning, and benchmarking using tools such as Terraform, Packer, and Ansible.
  • Evaluate emerging network security, AI, and platform technologies, and drive innovation through proofs of concept and reference implementations.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and lead design and code reviews.
  • Represent the team with customers, partners, and upstream open-source communities to speed up adoption of Intel-powered solutions.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in networking or systems software development.
  • Strong programming skills in C and/or C++/Rust on Linux, with Python, PowerShell or Bash for tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with high-performance networking technologies such as DPDK, VPP, or kernel networking/XDP.
  • Exposure to AI/ML technologies and concepts, such as model training and inference, neural network architectures (CNNs, transformers), and LLMs, and how they apply to network security workloads.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Power Integrity Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The world is transforming - and so is Intel. Intel is a company of bold and curious inventors and problem solvers who create some of the most astounding technology advancements and experiences in the world. With a legacy of relentless innovation and a commitment to bring smart, connected devices to every person on Earth, our diverse and brilliant teams are continually searching for tomorrow's technology and revel in the challenge that changing the world for the better brings. We work every single day to design and manufacture silicon products that empower people's digital lives. Come join us and do something wonderful.


As a Power Integrity Engineer, you will contribute to the development and validation of power delivery solutions for complex, high-speed silicon, package, and platform designs. You will work with cross-functional engineering teams to analyze, optimize, and validate power delivery networks from silicon through package and board.

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
• Develop and analyze power delivery networks (PDNs) for silicon, packages, boards, and high-speed platforms.
• Perform 2D and 3D electromagnetic model extraction and power-noise analysis across the end-to-end power delivery path, including die/C4 bumps, package, socket, and board.
• Define and evaluate power-grid specifications, power-noise budgets, and design targets to balance power integrity, performance, area, and platform requirements.
• Apply power integrity principles and simulation methodologies to guide package and platform design and physical implementation.
• Analyze PDN impedance, voltage droop, resonance, ground bounce, decoupling effectiveness, and other power-noise characteristics.
• Develop electrical analysis methodologies, test structures, and verification plans for power delivery design and validation.
• Perform laboratory measurements to characterize power noise across frequency, transient response, ground bounce, and other key PDN metrics.
• Correlate post-silicon/platform measurements with pre-silicon simulations and models to improve design accuracy and methodology.
• Evaluate and optimize on-die, package, and platform decoupling strategies.
• Support voltage regulator (VR) performance characterization and optimization as part of the overall platform power delivery solution.
• Develop platform-level power delivery and decoupling recommendations for incorporation into platform design guides.
• Translate silicon power requirements into package and platform-level specifications and support design pathfinding to meet performance and form-factor requirements.
• Collaborate with silicon integration, die floorplanning, package, board/platform, voltage regulator, and validation teams to optimize the end-to-end power delivery solution.

Qualifications:

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your degree, research and or relevant previous job and or internship experiences.


Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related STEM field & 1+ years of experience OR Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related STEM field & 0+ years of experience.


• 1+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
Power integrity or power delivery.
Power electronics.
Signal integrity.
Voltage regulator design or validation.
PCB/package electrical modeling.
Electrical simulation.
Electrical laboratory testing or validation.

Preferred Qualifications:
The following qualifications are considered a plus:
• Experience with printed circuit board (PCB) and/or semiconductor package design and technology.
• Experience analyzing power delivery networks, including impedance, voltage-noise, transient-response, or decoupling behavior.
• Experience with electrical simulation, electromagnetic extraction, or high-speed design tools such as HSPICE, Ansys HFSS, Keysight ADS, Cadence PowerSI, or Cadence PowerDC.
• Knowledge of transmission-line theory, electromagnetic-field concepts, and passive component parasitics.
• Knowledge of voltage regulator operation, control, transient response, and interaction with platform-level power delivery networks.
• Experience using electrical laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, voltage/current probes, power supplies, and related measurement equipment.
• Experience correlating simulation results with laboratory measurements.
• Programming or scripting experience for engineering analysis and automation, such as Python, MATLAB, or similar tools.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.

title: Power Delivery Integration and Power Rail Stress Engineer- SoC Power Thermal Performance Validation Engineer (Temporary position)
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

As a SoC Power Thermal Performance Validation and Optimization Engineer, you will play an essential role in ensuring Intel's products achieve optimal power, thermal, and performance benchmarks at the system-on-chip (SoC) level.


In this position, you will develop and execute validation methodologies, optimize hardware/software solutions, and perform SoC-level debugging to address power, thermal, and performance challenges. Your contribution will directly impact Intel's ability to deliver competitive, high-performing products to market.

This is a Temporary position (12 months)


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute System-on-Chip (SoC)-level power delivery, Power Rails Stress (PRS), maximum current (ICCmax), current transient (di/dt), minimum/maximum voltage (Vmin/Vmax), Digital Linear Voltage Regulator (DLVR)/Fully Integrated Voltage Regulator (FIVR), and concurrency plans, including feasibility study and design/verification/simulation of the Power Distribution Network (PDN) and sign-off of IR-drop/Electromigration (IR/EM) metrics, across Intel products.
  • Collaborate with architecture, design, firmware, software, Power Management architects, and layout teams to ensure power delivery meets competitive targets and specifications and to define and implement power gating solutions.
  • Establish and execute methodologies for validating hardware/software optimizations and to converge the design on all Power Distribution Network (PDN) metrics, ensuring alignment with business Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Perform System-on-Chip (SoC)-level debug to identify root causes and resolve functional and triage failures related to power delivery, on-die power grid/network, thermal, and performance.
  • Configure and set up data loggers to collect and analyze power/thermal data, and work with the package integration team to ensure the complete IP system meets the design specification.
  • Develop and maintain validation infrastructure (performance monitors, behavioral checkers, and testing environments) and work with the post-silicon debug team to triage, debug, and fix potential Power Distribution Network (PDN) issues.
  • Produce comprehensive validation reports summarizing activities and results and communicate findings effectively with relevant teams.
  • Drive continuous improvements to validation strategies, methodologies, and processes.

The ideal candidate should show the following behavioral traits

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective communication and documentation skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Advanced teamwork to work across teams in multi-faceted groups (architecture, design, verification, firmware, software, and platform teams).

Qualifications:

Minimum qualifications, you must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 1+ years of experience in System-on-Chip (SoC) power and performance validation and/or digital logic and optimization.
  • 1+ years of experience developing and / or optimization of power/performance Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and/or circuit design trade-off for power, performance, and area.
  • Intermediate to advanced English level.

Must have unrestricted, permanent right to work in Mexico (this role is not eligible for visa or immigration sponsorship).

Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

  • A master's degree is preferred.
  • Debugging experience for System-on-Chip (SoC)-level power, thermal, and performance failures.
  • Power Delivery design, implementation, and validation of high-performance and low-power designs.
  • Knowledge of hardware/software optimizations for power and performance.
  • Low power implementation techniques.
  • Experience with System-on-Chip (SoC)-level debug using Joint Test Action Group (JTAG) debuggers.
  • Familiarity with validation tools such as data acquisition/loggers, behavioral checkers, and state space coverage techniques.
  • Familiar with system board design/debugging and usage of lab equipment like Oscilloscope and Logic analyzer.
  • Experience with Power Delivery Integrity (PDI) validation infrastructure setup.

title: Core to Memory and I/O Engineer | SoC Power Thermal Performance Validation (Temporary position)
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

As a SoC Power Thermal Performance Validation and Optimization Engineer, you will play an essential role in ensuring Intel's products achieve optimal power, thermal, and performance benchmarks at the system-on-chip (SoC) level.


In this position, you will develop and execute validation methodologies, optimize hardware/software solutions, and perform SoC-level debugging to address power, thermal, and performance challenges. Your contribution will directly impact Intel's ability to deliver competitive, high-performing products to market.


This is a Temporary position (12 months)



Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute System-on-Chip (SoC)-level Core-to-Memory performance and Input/Output (I/O) to memory, Compute Express Link (CXL), Accelerators, and Concurrency validation and optimization plans across Intel products.
  • Collaborate with architecture, design, firmware, and software teams to ensure Core-to-Memory, Input/Output (I/O), and performance meet competitive targets and specifications.
  • Establish and execute Core-to-Memory (bandwidth, latency, workloads, benchmarks, tunings - prefetcher, Memory Controller, Core Building Block) and Input/Output to memory, Compute Express Link (CXL), Accelerators (Data Streaming Accelerator and In-Memory Analytics Accelerator), and Concurrency methodologies for validating hardware/software optimizations and ensure alignment with business Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Perform System-on-Chip (SoC)-level debug to identify root causes and resolve functional and triage failures related to Core-to-Memory performance and the Input/Output (I/O) domain.
  • Configure and set up performance monitors/tools and data loggers to collect and analyze Core-to-Memory and Input/Output transactions/data.
  • Develop and maintain validation infrastructure, including Core-to-Memory and Input/Output performance monitors, behavioral checkers, and testing environments.
  • Produce comprehensive validation reports summarizing activities and results and communicates findings effectively with relevant teams.
  • Drive continuous improvements to validation strategies, methodologies, and processes.

The ideal candidate should show the following behavioral traits


  • Strong analytical and problem-solving aptitude.
  • Effective communication and documentation skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Advanced teamwork skills to work across team in multi-faceted groups (architecture, design, verification, firmware, software, and platform teams).

Qualifications:

Minimum qualifications, you must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position.

  • Bachelors in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 1+ years of experience in core-to-memory (or similar performance validation area) and/or I/O (PCIe, CLX, Accelerators) validation.
  • 1+ years of experience developing and / or optimization of core-to-memory and I/O power/performance KPI's.
  • Intermediate to advanced English level.

Must have unrestricted, permanent right to work in Mexico (this role is not eligible for visa or immigration sponsorship).

Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

  • A Master's degree is preferred.
  • Debugging experience for SoC-level power, thermal, and performance failures.
  • Knowledge of hardware/software optimizations for performance workloads, benchmarks, and I/O validation.
  • Experience with System (SoC) level debug using JTAG debuggers.
  • Familiarity with validation tools such as performance monitors/counters, data acquisition/loggers, behavioral checkers, and state space coverage techniques.
  • Familiar with system board design/debugging and usage of lab equipment like Oscilloscope and Logic analyzer.
  • Experience with core-to-memory and I/O performance modeling, benchmarking, and validation infrastructure setup.
  • Experience with Python Programming language.

Requirements may be met through a combination of relevant industry experience, internship experience, and/or academic work, coursework, or research.

title: Director, Government Affairs - Taiwan
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

About the Role
Join Intel and help build a better tomorrow. Intel is in the midst of an exciting transformation, with a vision to create and extend computing technology that connects and enriches the lives of every person on Earth. Join us and help create the next generation of technologies that will shape the future for decades to come.
Intel's International Government Affairs team is seeking a dynamic and experienced leader to join our Taiwan team as Director of Government Affairs.
In this role, you will work closely with Intel Taiwan, the Director for Taiwan International Government Affairs ( IGA) and the Vice President of International Government Affairs to develop and execute a comprehensive government relations strategy that supports a favorable semiconductor policy and regulatory environment for Intel's growth and operations.
The Director will also be responsible for maintaining excellent relationships and networks with key government stakeholders at the national, prefectural, and local levels. This leader will play an important role in positively positioning Intel, building a sound reputation and position of influence for the company, and establishing Intel as a trusted and influential partner in Taiwan..
Key Responsibilities
The Director of Taiwan Government Affairs will:
• Represent Intel on legislative and regulatory matters with relevant government bodies and support the implementation of all phases of regulatory strategy to help secure necessary approvals for company products and services.
• Provide strategic policy direction and coordinate Intel's efforts to engage with government, both directly and through key opinion leaders, industry associations, foreign diplomatic missions, business chambers, media, and public-private partnerships.
• Develop and implement programs that increase awareness and appreciation of Intel's value proposition and strengthen the company's reputation in Taiwan.
• Oversee Intel's lobbying activities in Taiwan and provide strategic direction and oversight to lobbyists, consultants, industry associations, and other external organizations engaged by Intel.
• Establish and maintain strong relationships with external partners, industry organizations, business chambers, regulators, policymakers, and key opinion leaders.
• Work closely with the Government of Taiwan, including various ministries, universities, national laboratories, and other relevant institutions to influence key decisions and position Intel as a trusted partner.
• Monitor the industry and government for intelligence sensing of emerging issues, anticompetitive behavior, and related risks, and advise on necessary action.
• Partner closely with Intel Taiwan and internal stakeholders, including Sales and Marketing, Bus and the Digital Readiness program to identify key engagement opportunities and develop coordinated government engagement strategies that support Intel's business objectives and long-term success.
• Serve as an active member of the broader business community by participating in relevant activities and initiatives, including leadership and engagement with business chambers, industry associations, and other external organizations.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:


• Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Public Policy, Government Relations, Political Science, Law, or a related field.

The Role and Impact
As a Graduate Talent in the Client Validation Engineering (CVE) team, you will play a critical role in validating the architectural features of Intel's next-generation CPUs, PCH chipsets, and custom ASICs. Your day-to-day activities will include developing test plans, creating validation environments, and executing tests to ensure silicon-level functionality and reliability. By identifying design implementation bugs and ensuring performance to specifications, you will directly contribute to delivering high-quality products to Intel's market segments.

title: Yield Defect Metrology Technician Undergraduate Intern
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Position Overview As a Yield Defect Metrology Technician Undergraduate Intern, you will gain hands-on experience in semiconductor manufacturing by supporting defect review and metrology activities. Working closely with experienced engineers and technicians, you will learn how automated inspection systems identify defects, how defect images are analysed, and how quality decisions contribute to yield improvement. This internship offers valuable exposure to advanced semiconductor inspection technologies, defect classification techniques, data analysis, and manufacturing quality systems. You will have the opportunity to develop technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills while contributing to real production support activities. Key Responsibilities Defect Review and Classification Support • Review defect images captured by various semiconductor inspection and metrology tools. • Assist in classifying defects according to established defect specifications and guidelines. • Learn to differentiate between actual defects and non-critical defects under supervision. • Support the collection and organization of defect classification data. • Maintain accurate records of reviewed cases and findings. Defect Validation Support • Assist engineers and technicians in validating defect classifications against documented criteria. • Participate in defect review discussions and case studies to enhance technical understanding. • Support data preparation activities to improve Automated Defect Classification (ADC) model accuracy. • Learn best practices for maintaining consistency in defect review processes. Manufacturing Quality Support • Assist in reviewing production lots requiring additional inspection. • Ensure quality records and documentation are completed accurately. • Learn how Out-of-Control Action Plans (OCAP) are used to support manufacturing quality decisions. • Support continuous improvement activities related to defect reduction and process monitoring. Data Analysis and Reporting • Compile defect review data and create basic summaries and reports. • Identify recurring defect trends and escalate observations to mentors or engineers. • Support data-driven improvement projects and operational excellence initiatives. • Participate in team meetings and provide updates on assigned activities. title: 3DIC Device Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

About the Team

Manufacturing Development and Customer Engineering (MDCE) serves as the critical bridge between Technology Development (TD) and High Volume Manufacturing (HVM) within Intel Foundry. The organization is responsible for transitioning leading-edge technologies from development and qualification into high-yield production while enabling successful deployment for foundry customers.


The MDCE Device Team is expanding its 3DIC device engineering capabilities and is seeking an experienced engineer to drive device understanding and optimization for advanced 3D integration technologies.


Position Overview

As a 3DIC Device Development Engineer, you will be responsible for understanding, characterizing, and modeling the impact of advanced 3D integration technologies on transistor and passive device performance. Technologies such as through-silicon vias (TSVs), hybrid bonding, active base die architectures, wafer thinning, and backside power delivery introduce new mechanical, thermal, and electrical interactions that influence device behavior, variability, and reliability.


In this role, you will transform complex silicon data into actionable insights, design rules, device collateral, and customer-ready guidance that support next-generation products including AI accelerators, high-performance computing solutions, and high-bandwidth memory (HBM) platforms.


Key Responsibilities


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Characterize and model the impact of advanced 3D integration technologies, including TSVs, hybrid bonding, wafer thinning, and backside processing, on device performance metrics such as mobility, threshold voltage (Vt), leakage, matching, and variability.
  • Evaluate stress, thermal, and electrical coupling effects, including keep-out zone (KOZ) behavior and device interactions within complex 3D stacks.
  • Define and develop device and passive test structures to study 3DIC effects, including TSV proximity, KOZ, guard ring, resistor, and capacitor structures.
  • Drive electrical test (e-test) strategy, data collection, and silicon analysis to accelerate technology learning and optimization.
  • Provide device characterization inputs that enable design rule development, compact models, PDKs, and 3D design kit releases in collaboration with Design Enablement teams.
  • Partner closely with Process Integration, Packaging, Assembly, Reliability, Yield, and Program Management organizations to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve device-related issues.
  • Evaluate customer requirements for analog, mixed-signal, RF, and high-speed I/O devices within 3D architectures, assessing technical feasibility, risk, and implementation timelines.
  • Support technology qualification and manufacturing readiness activities, including device targeting, monitoring strategies, yield improvement efforts, and excursion management.
  • Communicate complex technical findings and recommendations to engineering, business, and customer stakeholders.

What We Are Looking For


The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Deep understanding of CMOS device physics and the impact of process, stress, and thermal effects on device performance.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including data science, statistical analysis, and scripting capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Proven ability to influence and collaborate across device, process, packaging, manufacturing, and design organizations.
  • Strong ownership mindset, technical curiosity, and a passion for developing innovative solutions in advanced semiconductor technologies.

Qualifications:

The Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position.  Minimum qualifications listed below would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experience and / or schoolwork/classes/research. The preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a related field with 4+ years of industry experience, in semiconductor device engineering, process integration, advanced packaging, or related technology development.
  • 3+ years of experience in advanced CMOS device characterization and electrical parametric (e-test) data analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more advanced packaging and 3D integration technologies, including:
    • Through-silicon vias (TSVs)
    • Hybrid bonding
    • Wafer-to-wafer or die-to-wafer bonding
    • Micro-bump technologies
    • Wafer thinning
    • Backside power delivery

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a related field.
  • Experience analyzing stress and thermal interactions affecting device behavior, including TSV keep-out zones and chip-package interaction effects.
  • Expertise in test structure development, design of experiments (DOE), and e-test program implementation.
  • Knowledge of device modeling, design rule development, PDK generation, or design technology co-optimization (DTCO).
  • Experience using TCAD and/or finite element analysis tools for stress, thermal, or device simulations.
  • Understanding of semiconductor reliability mechanisms, including electromigration (EM), time-dependent dielectric breakdown (TDDB), bias temperature instability (BTI), and bonding interface reliability.
  • Experience with advanced node technologies, including FinFET and Gate-All-Around (GAA) devices.
  • Semiconductor foundry experience with direct customer engagement and technical support.
  • Experience supporting technology transfer and production ramp in high-volume manufacturing environments.

Join us in shaping the future of semiconductor innovation through advanced 3D integration technologies that enable the next generation of AI, HPC, and memory solutions.

title: Sr SOC Emulation Validation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Role and Impact As a SoC Design Verification Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring Intel's next-generation Client CPU System-on-Chip (SoC) designs meet functional specifications and deliver top-tier quality. You will execute verification plans, develop reusable test environments, and identify and resolve bugs in pre-silicon designs to validate functionality and performance. Your contributions will directly support the successful delivery of cutting-edge products built for the era of hyper-scale computing. Business group Intel Corporation is at the forefront of innovation, advancing technology to empower global progress. The team is part of Intel's design and development group, focused on delivering high-quality, high-performance SoC solutions for next-generation products. Through collaboration across architecture, design, and post-silicon teams, the group ensures optimized functionality and reliability for Intel's cutting-edge chips. Key Responsibilities - Develop scalable and reusable verification plans, test benches, and environments to validate functional logic for integrated SoC designs. - Execute simulations and emulation models to verify design accuracy, analyze power and performance, and uncover potential issues. - Debug failing tests, root cause issues, and implement corrective measures within pre-silicon environments. - Collaborate closely with architects, microarchitects, RTL developers, and other design teams to improve verification coverage and methodologies. - Incorporate security activities and regression tests into validation plans to ensure comprehensive protection of SoC designs. - Document test plans and drive technical reviews with cross-functional teams to optimize design verification strategies. - Absorb post-silicon feedback to enhance validation methodologies for future products.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications - Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science with 4+ years of hands-on experience in SoC design verification OR Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science with 3+ years of experience. - Proficiency in developing test plans, simulation models, and debug procedures for complex SoC designs. - Experience with verification tools such as UVM, SystemVerilog, and emulation platforms. - Strong technical expertise in RTL design and verification methodologies. - Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Python, Perl) for process automation. Preferred Qualifications - Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to address architectural and microarchitectural challenges. - Experience in leveraging learning from post-silicon validation to enhance pre-silicon processes. - Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail in identifying and resolving design issues. - Passion for innovation and continuous improvement in SoC design verification strategies. Be part of shaping cutting-edge technology and collaborate with industry leaders to deliver world-class solutions. Join us in driving the future of computing.

title: C4 Bump Module Equipment Technician
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Join Intel Malaysia's newest Advanced Packaging startup team in Penang and help shape the future of semiconductor manufacturing. As part of a factory ramp from the ground up, you will work with advanced wafer manufacturing and packaging technologies, collaborate with global engineering teams, and play a key role in bringing new capabilities into high-volume production. This unique opportunity offers unparalleled exposure to factory startup activities, rapid professional growth, and the chance to leave your mark on one of Intel's most significant manufacturing expansions.


Job Summary

  • The Equipment Technician plays a critical role in the startup, ramp, and sustained operation of advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment supporting high-volume Advanced Packaging production.
  • This position is responsible for maintaining equipment performance, reliability, and availability through troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, equipment recovery, and continuous improvement activities.
  • The Equipment Technician partners closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Facilities, and equipment suppliers to support manufacturing readiness, operational excellence, yield, quality, and factory output while ensuring compliance with safety, environmental, and quality requirements.
  • Performs electrical, mechanical, electronic, and/or mechatronic troubleshooting to identify and resolve problems with semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
  • Performs equipment setup, calibration, preventive maintenance, repair, adjustment, component replacement, and equipment recovery in accordance with approved procedures, specifications, equipment manuals, drawings, and safety requirements.
  • Monitors and analyzes equipment performance and manufacturing data to identify abnormalities, equipment degradation, and conditions that may affect equipment availability, process stability, manufacturing output, yield, or product quality.
  • Responds to equipment alarms, equipment-related excursions, and manufacturing interruptions in accordance with established procedures to restore equipment to required operating conditions.
  • Collects relevant equipment data, performs authorized troubleshooting, and works with Equipment, Module, and Process Engineering teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
  • Performs routine equipment health monitoring and supports the early identification of equipment conditions or trends that could impact manufacturing performance, reliability, capacity, or manufacturing readiness.
  • Works with Engineering teams to execute approved experiments, equipment characterization, process qualifications, equipment configuration changes, and continuous improvement initiatives. Supports equipment troubleshooting through data analysis, root cause investigation, and controlled experimentation to maintain or improve equipment availability, reliability, performance, and manufacturing readiness.
  • Supports established Statistical Process Control (SPC), equipment monitoring, fault detection, and manufacturing control systems by responding to equipment-related abnormalities according to defined procedures and escalation requirements.
  • Utilizes equipment performance data and system indicators to proactively identify opportunities for improved equipment stability and operational performance.
  • Coordinates with OEMs, equipment suppliers, and technical support organizations for troubleshooting, repair, servicing, component replacement, equipment recovery, and reliability improvements when required.
  • Works closely with Equipment Engineering, Process Engineering, Manufacturing, Facilities, and other support teams to resolve equipment-related manufacturing issues and support production objectives.
  • Creates and maintains equipment failure reports, maintenance records, troubleshooting documentation, calibration records, qualification records, and other technical documentation supporting equipment performance, reliability, and compliance requirements.
  • During factory startup and ramp, supports equipment installation, acceptance, setup, conversion, qualification, and manufacturing readiness activities in accordance with approved designs, specifications, and procedures.
  • Contributes to the successful introduction of new equipment, technologies, and manufacturing capabilities supporting Advanced Packaging operations.
  • Drives a culture of safety, quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Performs assigned work in accordance with applicable EHS, cleanroom, quality, contamination control, and manufacturing work-control requirements.

Qualifications:

Education

  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Experience

  • Fresh graduates with strong technical aptitude and an interest in semiconductor manufacturing are encouraged to apply.
  • Relevant experience in semiconductor manufacturing, Advanced Packaging, electronics manufacturing, equipment maintenance, equipment troubleshooting, automation, or other high-volume manufacturing environments is an advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor manufacturing equipment troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, repair, setup, calibration, and equipment recovery.
  • Familiarity with semiconductor wafer fabrication, Advanced Packaging, assembly, test, or other high-volume manufacturing processes and equipment.
  • Familiarity with equipment and process monitoring methodologies, including Statistical Process Control (SPC), equipment performance monitoring, excursion management, and data-driven problem solving.
  • Experience interpreting equipment alarms, diagnostic information, technical documentation, schematics, engineering drawings, specifications, maintenance procedures, and equipment manuals.
  • Familiarity with structured troubleshooting methodologies, failure analysis, root cause investigation, and implementation of corrective actions.
  • Experience supporting equipment installation, startup, qualification, manufacturing readiness, production ramp, or equipment conversion activities is an added advantage.
  • Familiarity with automated material handling systems (AMHS), robotics, wafer handling systems, process equipment, metrology tools, automation platforms, manufacturing execution systems (MES), and manufacturing control systems is an added advantage.
  • Experience working with OEMs, suppliers, or technical service organizations to support equipment troubleshooting and maintenance activities is an added advantage.

Other Requirements

  • Strong technical aptitude and systematic problem-solving skills.
  • Basic understanding of mechanical, electrical, electronic, automation, pneumatic, vacuum, and/or mechatronic systems.
  • Basic understanding of semiconductor manufacturing operations and the relationship between equipment condition, process stability, yield, manufacturing performance, and product quality.
  • Ability to interpret and follow technical documentation, equipment manuals, schematics, specifications, maintenance procedures, and work instructions.
  • Ability to identify abnormal equipment or manufacturing conditions and respond or escalate in accordance with established procedures.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills, including the ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, Manufacturing, Facilities, OEMs, suppliers, and cross-functional support teams.
  • Demonstrated learning agility and the ability to quickly acquire proficiency on new equipment, manufacturing processes, automation systems, and technologies.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to safety, quality, equipment reliability, and operational excellence.
  • Willing and able to work in a semiconductor cleanroom environment while adhering to contamination control, safety, and quality requirements.
  • Demonstrated flexibility and willingness to support factory startup, equipment installation, qualification, production ramp, and evolving manufacturing requirements in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • This role requires regular onsite presence to fulfill essential job responsibilities.
  • Willing and able to work shift schedules, including rotating day and night shifts, as required to support manufacturing operations.
  • Able to support overtime, weekends, public holidays, factory startup, production ramp, and equipment recovery activities based on business and manufacturing requirements.

title: Senior Power Integrity Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Role and Impact

We are seeking a skilled Power Integrity Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of advanced power delivery solutions. In this role, you will analyze, design, and verify power integrity networks across silicon, packages, and platforms, ensuring optimal performance and functionality. Your work will directly impact product quality and reliability, enabling Intel to deliver state-of-the-art solutions that meet the demands of next-generation technology.


Business group

The position resides within Intel Corporation, a global technology leader that drives innovation in computing, communications, and data-centric technologies. The team focuses on delivering cutting-edge solutions for complex platform designs, supporting Intel's broader mission of creating world-changing technology. As part of this group, you will have the opportunity to collaborate across domains to solve challenging problems and shape the future of computing.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and analyze power delivery networks using 2D and 3D model extraction and noise analysis across silicon, packages, sockets, and boards.
  • Define power grid specifications and targets to balance power integrity with performance.
  • Perform measurements to characterize power noise profiles and correlate back to pre-silicon estimations.
  • Create test structures, verification plans, and methodologies to address power integrity challenges.
  • Simulate power networks and guide package and platform physical implementation strategies.
  • Ensure on-die power noise meets SoC and other platform functionality and performance requirements.
  • Develop platform-level power shapes and decoupling solutions as part of platform design guidelines.
  • Collaborate with silicon integration teams, die floor planners, and package design teams to optimize power delivery and voltage regulation schemes.

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with 6+ years of relevant experience; OR a Master's degree with 4+ years of relevant experience; OR a PhD with 2+ years of relevant experience in power integrity engineering or related domains.
  • Proficiency in power integrity simulation tools and methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience with power delivery measurements and characterization methods.
  • Solid knowledge of 2D and 3D modeling, electrical analysis, and noise estimation techniques.
  • Understanding of power delivery network design and trade-offs across silicon, package, and platform levels.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience in defining specifications and contributing to platform-level design strategies.
  • Knowledge of voltage regulation, decoupling schemes, and package pathfinding processes.
  • A passion for innovation and problem-solving in complex, high-speed systems.

Your expertise can drive significant advancements in Intel's innovative technologies. If you are ready to take on this challenging and impactful role, we encourage you to apply today.

title: Junior CPU Verification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

Who We Are

At Intel, we are shaping the future of computing. Our engineering teams develop the technologies that power billions of devices worldwide, from personal computers and cloud infrastructure to edge computing and artificial intelligence applications.


Join Intel's CPU Design team and become part of a world-class engineering organization responsible for designing and verifying next-generation processor technologies. As a Junior CPU Verification Engineer, you will work alongside experienced architects, designers, and verification engineers to ensure the quality, functionality, and performance of Intel's future CPU products.


The Role

As a CPU Verification Engineer, you will be responsible for verifying complex processor designs before they reach silicon. You will develop verification environments, create test plans, debug failures, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure Intel CPUs meet functional, performance, power, and quality objectives.


What You’ll Do

Responsibilities may include but are not limited to:


  • Performs functional verification of CPU logic to ensure design will meet specification requirements.
  • Develops IP verification plans, test benches, and the verification environment to ensure coverage to confirm to CPU microarchitecture specifications.
  • Executes verification plans and defines and runs system simulation models to verify the design, analyze power and timing, and uncover bugs.
  • Replicates, root causes, and debugs issues in the presilicon environment.
  • Finds and implements corrective measures to resolve failing tests.
  • Collaborates with CPU architects, RTL developers, and physical design teams to improve verification of complex architectural and microarchitectural features and to meet functional, performance, and power goals.
  • Documents test plans and drive technical reviews of plans and proofs with design and architecture teams.
  • Maintains and improves existing functional verification infrastructure and methodology.
  • Participates in the definition of architecture and microarchitecture features of the CPU being designed actively.

Behavioral traits that we are looking for:

  • Strong analytical thinking and a passion for solving complex technical challenges.
  • Curiosity and eagerness to continuously learn new technologies, tools, and methodologies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Effective collaboration and teamwork across multidisciplinary engineering organizations.

descriptionHtml:

Engineering studies will include performance risk assessments developing default setting recommendations architectural studies of existing and contemplated features defining new thermally relevant workloads assessment of generation-to-generation performance impacts and debugging of customer or internally observed behavior.

title: CPU Circuit Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The world is transforming - and so is Intel. Intel is a company of bold and curious inventors and problem solvers who create some of the most astounding technology advancements and experiences in the world. With a legacy of relentless innovation and a commitment to bring smart, connected devices to every person on Earth, our diverse and brilliant teams are continually searching for tomorrow's technology and revel in the challenge that changing the world for the better brings. We work every single day to design and manufacture silicon products that empower people's digital lives. Come join us and do something wonderful.


The Role and Impact
As a CPU Circuit Design Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the performance of Intel's cutting-edge CPUs. You will design, simulate, and optimize circuits to achieve the best trade-offs between speed, power, area, and reliability, ensuring that our products meet stringent quality and schedule demands. Your contributions will directly impact the functionality and efficiency of Intel's leading technologies, driving innovation and delivering exceptional results.

Business Group
At Intel Corporation, the Atom Circuit P2 team focuses on advancing circuit designs that enable next-generation CPU performance and innovation. This group plays a key role in developing technologies that power Intel's products, working collaboratively across domains to tackle complex design challenges. The team's work supports Intel's broader commitment to delivering world-class silicon solutions that transform industries and improve lives.

Responsibilities:

  • Drives performance verification (PV) methodology and circuit / timing quality signoff for the CPU team.
  • Evaluates new process nodes through circuit simulations and/or block scaling methods, recommends frequency targets for the CPU with an early understanding of u-architectural growth.
  • Makes informed trade-offs between performance, power, area, and effort.
  • Works with design domains RTL/circuit/SD to converge to timing targets with no compromise on quality or schedule.
  • In addition to pre-silicon responsibilities, this individual will grow to own pre-to-post silicon VF correlation and drive debug of circuit marginality sightings.
  • Must demonstrate a track record of execution and design ownership in advanced process technologies.

Qualifications:

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your degree, research and or relevant previous job and or internship experiences. 


Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelors & 6+ years or Masters & 4+ years in Electrical & Computer Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field.

  • 5+ years of CPU circuit or backend design experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in circuit design and STA.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • In-depth circuit design knowledge and ability to make PPA tradeoff decisions.
  • In-depth STA knowledge and circuit quality signoff criteria for tape-in.
  • Ability to guide debug of post-silicon circuit marginality sightings.
  • Ability to handle incomplete, fuzzy task definitions and drive them to closure.
  • Hands on individual contributor who can delegate when necessary to meet stringent schedules.
  • Led technical teams of 2-3 engineers.
  • Self-motivated, team player and easy to work with.

Join us in building world-class technology that transforms industries and enriches lives. Together, we can do something wonderful.
